titulo: Delete GTA 6 For A Chance To Win Another Game
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases this week. The game looms so large that other companies are using it to market their own games, including Devolver Digital. The publisher has announced that people can enter for a chance to win their upcoming game, Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, by reposting the message below with a video of themselves deleting their GTA 6 pre-load. Of course, anyone who deletes their pre-load can install it again, though it might take some time given the game is 212GB . https://twitter.com/devolverdigital/status/2122404424983146756 The lucky winners will get a Steam key for Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed , not a console code since the game's console plans haven't been confirmed yet, so that's something to keep in mind if you're taking part in this campaign. titulo: The Head Of GTA 6’s Parent Company Helped Make One Of The Best Christmas Movies Of All Time
texto: One of the most memorable and beloved Christmas movies is 1990's Home Alone, but it almost didn't happen, and the head of GTA 6 's parent company played a role in bringing the movie to market. Strauss Zelnick, the current CEO of Rockstar Games owner Take-Two, was the president and COO of 20th Century Fox at the time--he was among the youngest-ever Hollywood CEOs at the age of 32. Warner Bros. was originally backing Home Alone and had actually begun production on the movie until budget concerns prompted the studio to pull the plug. "Four days into production, they shut down the picture and canceled it.
